units.source_text: 原来源氏和内大臣表面上虽然亲睦，但为了此种事情，自昔就常常赌气。

en.t: Although Genji and the Minister of the Interior had always appeared friendly on the surface, they had long been prone to taking offense at one another over such matters.

units.source_text: 最近内大臣不肯把云居雁嫁给夕雾，使得夕雾大受委屈，

en.t: Recently, the Minister of the Interior had refused to let Kumoi no Kari marry Yugiri, causing Yugiri to suffer a deep grievance,

units.source_text: 以致伤心失意，源氏旁气难忍，因而说这种讽刺话，希望其传入内大臣耳中，教他也气一气。

en.t: so that he was heartbroken and dejected; Genji, indignant on his behalf, could not bear it and therefore made these sarcastic remarks, hoping they would reach the Minister's ears and make him angry too.

units.source_text: 源氏闻知内大臣找到了一个女儿之后，想道：“如果把玉鬘给他看，

en.t: After Genji heard that the Minister of the Interior had found a daughter, he thought, "If I were to show Tamakazura to him,

units.source_text: 他看见她容貌美丽，一定很疼爱。

en.t: once he saw how beautiful she was, he would surely cherish her dearly.

units.source_text: 内大臣为人直爽善断，察察为明，善恶褒贬，丝毫不苟，性行迥异常人。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior is frank and decisive by nature, sharp in observation, exacting in judging good and bad and in praise or blame, and altogether quite unlike ordinary people in temperament and conduct.

units.source_text: 如果他知道我藏着玉鬘，定然非常恨我。

en.t: If he learned that I had been hiding Tamakazura, he would certainly hate me bitterly.

units.source_text: 但倘不预先告诉他，突然把玉鬘送去，

en.t: But if I do not tell him beforehand and suddenly send Tamakazura to him,

units.source_text: 他看见她容貌美丽，自然不会轻视，一定郑重其事地教养她。”

en.t: then, seeing her beauty, he naturally would not slight her and would surely take her upbringing very seriously."

units.source_text: 此时晚风吹来，十分凉快，诸青年都舍不得回去。

en.t: Just then the evening breeze began to blow, pleasantly cool, and all the young men were reluctant to go home.

units.source_text: 源氏说：“跟你们在这里纳凉，真好舒服啊！

en.t: Genji said, "It is truly pleasant to cool off here with all of you.

units.source_text: 只怕我这把年纪，夹在这里要被你们讨厌的。”

en.t: I only fear that, at my age, joining in among you like this may make you dislike my company."

units.source_text: 说着，便走向玉鬘那边去。

en.t: As he said this, he went off toward Tamakazura's quarters.
The young men all rose and accompanied him as they saw him off.
